id: title:danielcarletti:parse text timestamps before matching replayed cdc rows

review.posthog_relevance: PostHog warehouse ingestion compatibility and metadata preservation
review.reason: Adds datetime parsing utility and warehouse-specific timestamp handling, including fallback parsing and schema-based casting, to support warehouse compatibility and prevent incorrect type coercion.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual warehouse compatibility or ingestion success.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds import of safe_parse_datetime alongside normalize_column_name.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the datetime parsing utility used later to normalize timestamp strings before casting, supporting the new timestamp handling logic.

observations.behavior: Changes column casting to use the target type from the schema rather than the field's stored type, and adds a fallback parsing step before adding to the stringly set.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the CDC ingestion pipeline to distinguish between a column that can be safely cast and one that requires parsing, preventing incorrect type coercion and preserving compatibility with warehouse metadata.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function _parse_timestamps that uses safe_parse_datetime to convert timestamp strings to the target Arrow type, returning None if parsing fails or if the parser rejects the value.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the parsing strategy for warehouse-provided timestamps, ensuring that the ingestion layer can handle warehouse-specific timestamp formats before storing them in PostHog's warehouse-compatible representation.
